audience: finance and admin teams in Australia and New Zealand that run card spend and budgets in Weel

useCases.title: Find card transactions that still need an expense
useCases.text: List transactions with the expense-completion filter, newest first. Open one transaction for its amount and GST.

useCases.title: Check balances in each currency
useCases.text: Read the real-time balance for each currency of the business. Then list the statements for a date range.

useCases.title: Review budgets and their members
useCases.text: List the budgets, filtered by type or member limit. Open one budget, then list the members invited to it.

useCases.title: Check which budgets a user belongs to
useCases.text: List the users of the business, then list the budgets that one user is a member of.

useCases.title: Map expenses to tags and accounting codes
useCases.text: List the custom fields and their options, and the general ledger accounting codes of the business.
